title: 500+ SKU Multi-Variant Catalog Restructuring & Matrixify Bulk Migration
summary: End-to-end catalog restructuring transforming raw supplier inventory sheets into a standardized Matrixify schema for Shopify OS 2.0 with multi-variant matrices, barcode validation, and automated smart collection rules.
problem: E-commerce store owners frequently receive unstructured product feeds from wholesale suppliers with merged size/color options in single cells, missing variant SKUs, duplicate URL handles, and zero barcode validation, causing failed bulk imports and catalog inventory mismatches.
whatIDid: Cleaned and normalized raw supplier spreadsheets by parsing composite variant strings into dedicated Option1 (Size) and Option2 (Color) relational matrices.
Engineered programmatic kebab-case URL handles ensuring parent-child variant grouping and zero duplicate handle collisions.
Generated standardized SKU naming hierarchies (BRAND-CAT-SIZE-COLOR) and cross-checked 1,500+ barcode entries with validation formulas to prevent duplicate inventory records.
Structured Shopify OS 2.0 native metafield attributes (specifications, dimensions, care guides) directly into Matrixify import columns for automated PDP accordion population.
Authored high-converting SEO page titles, meta descriptions, and image alt-tags targeting purchase-intent search keywords.
Configured automated smart collection tags allowing instant storefront merchandising without manual product-by-product assignment.
result: Successfully restructured and prepared 520+ parent products into 1,560 child variants with 100% data validation accuracy, eliminating manual listing overhead and enabling error-free Matrixify bulk store deployment.
